brief.zh: 夜班需要 2 盏提灯、3 节电池、1 只夹子和 2 块布。草稿上的布数量已经正确，磁铁和珠子都应去掉。请 AI 交回一份逐项列出数量的清单。
brief.en: The night shift needs 2 lanterns, 3 batteries, 1 clip, and 2 cloths. The draft already has the right count for cloths. Remove both magnets and beads. Ask AI to return a checklist with one count per item.

concept.zh: 综合明确的目标、数量和排除条件，确认随后的清单修正也遵守限制。
concept.en: Combine a clear goal, exact counts, and exclusions. Check that the revised list still follows the constraints.

hints.zh: 先列出四种需要的用品与数量，再分别说明两种不允许的用品。
hints.en: First name the four required items and counts, then exclude each forbidden item.

hints.zh: 检查 AI 的清单是否还漏了一项。
hints.en: Look for a required item the AI may have missed.

cards.zh: 生成逐项列出数量的清单。
cards.en: Return a checklist with one count per item.

zh: 生成逐项列出数量的清单。提灯：2盏。电池：3节。夹子：1只。保留2块布。去掉磁铁。去掉珠子。
夹子改为1只。其他项目保持原样。
en: Return a checklist with one count per item. Lanterns: 2. Batteries: 3. Clip: 1. Keep 2 cloths. Remove magnets. Remove beads.
Set clips to 1. Keep the other entries.
